title: Bharat Last-Mile ID Participant Metadata for Levels 1 and 2
description: Machine-discoverable capabilities, public keys, and optional event receiver information for an LMID participant domain.

domain.description: Canonical bare domain that owns this metadata document and identifies the LMID participant.

display_name.description: Participant-controlled public display name shown together with the canonical domain.

roles.description: LMID protocol roles performed by this participant.

jwks_uri.description: HTTPS URI of the participant's public LMID JWK Set for pass and HTTP message signature verification.

versions_supported.description: LMID wire-format versions supported by the participant, separate from capability levels. Level 2 event support is advertised through event_receiver.

token_types_supported.description: Explicit JWS typ values emitted by the participant when it acts as a pass issuer.

photo_origins.description: Additional HTTPS origins from which a reader may retrieve holder photographs referenced by this participant's passes.

event_receiver.description: Optional Level 2 HTTPS receiver and event types accepted by this participant.

roles.description: Detects metadata claiming the issuer role.

token_types_supported.description: Requires an issuer to advertise the LMID pass token type.

uri.description: HTTPS endpoint that accepts signed LMID CloudEvents by HTTP POST.

types_supported.description: LMID event type strings accepted by the receiver.
